title: Q-FIND-open-questions: make https://open-questions.ultrastable.org/ findable (5 gaps)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** findable workflow, daily
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation findable --probe open-questions
**Prediction:** findable_gaps <= 0 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** paid listings, new accounts, and any page that is not this property's own
**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation findable --probe open-questions
**Status:** open

https://open-questions.ultrastable.org/ is missing what search engines and AI agents read: Open Graph title; schema.org JSON-LD; robots.txt names no sitemap; no sitemap.xml with urls; no llms.txt. Fix the property's own pages (shared seed modules first, so every system gets it). Closed by the same daily reading.
